name: fmage
description: Generate and reference-edit images through independent OpenAI Images, Gemini/Nano Banana, and Midjourney adapters, with expanded and direct prompt entries and a local image-regression pipeline.

interface.shortDescription: Provider image tools plus local image regression.
interface.longDescription: Adds first-class image generation and editing tools with separate Fmage image-generation and Fmage direct-generation entries, switchable local provider configuration, and a fixed local Pillow workflow for proportional 1K downscaling, Gaussian blur, and monochrome luminance noise. API keys remain outside the shareable plugin directory.
defaultPrompt: Edit this reference image with Fmage.
Use $fmage-direct to submit this image prompt without rewriting.
